title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation
one: 冻结 policy，把 Action → State Change 写入因果交互记忆，用 Context 让重复尝试越来越好。
project: 启发 Physical Experience 的基本单位从单帧 state 提升到 action–effect transition；长期可研究 Fast Memory + Slow RL。

title: RL Token: Bootstrapping Online RL with Vision-Language-Action Models
one: 冻结大 VLA，用紧凑 readout + 轻量 actor-critic 做样本高效在线适应。
project: 当前项目的技术脚手架；主线不是“改 RL Token”，而是 Physical Interaction + Self-Improvement。

title: SmoothRL: Online Reinforcement Learning During Asynchronous Execution
one: 异步执行下 generated chunk ≠ executed chunk，只强化真正执行的 action region。
project: 如果后续改 async，必须先把 executed action / transition / credit assignment 定义正确。

title: Harness VLA: Steering Frozen VLAs into Reliable Manipulation Primitives via Memory-Guided Agents
one: 把冻结 VLA 当作可验证、可重试 primitive，由 memory-guided agent 负责 re-ground / retry / recovery。
project: 用于区分 primitive 本身失败与 orchestration 失败；近期不改变 RLT baseline 优先级。

title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
one: 冻结 foundation model，通过 rollout 演化 reusable skills 与 harness。
project: 提醒我们自进化不只等于 weight update，但局部 physical control 仍需独立验证。

title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
one: 用多时间尺度 harness 演化 runtime critic 和 recovery skills，并在验证后再写入 skill memory。
project: 很值得借鉴 validation-gated experience consolidation。

title: Pri4R: Learning World Dynamics for VLA with Privileged 4D Representation
one: 训练期用 future 3D/4D geometry 监督 VLA 表征，部署保持原输入。
project: 压缩单纯 Physical Token 的创新空间；必须证明 decision-relevant consequence 对在线适应的增量。
